about: Retrieval golden set: real employee questions (worded differently from the documents) and WHERE the answer is. A retrieved chunk is relevant if it comes from one of the 'answers' files AND contains that answer phrase. Works for any chunking method.

answers: notice period for all permanent employees is 60 days
